import sqlite3, hashlib, json
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

conn = sqlite3.connect("{{db_path}}")
conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emb(k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT)")
model = SentenceTransformer("all-MiniLM-L6-v2")

def embed(text: str) -> list[float]:
    k = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
    row = conn.execute("SELECT v FROM emb WHERE k=?", (k,)).fetchone()
    if row:
        return json.loads(row[0])
    v = model.encode(text, normalize_embeddings=True).tolist()
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO emb(k,v) VALUES(?,?)", (k, json.dumps(v)))
    conn.commit()
    return v
